scenes.title: The NL Scholarship is open for 2027-28.
scenes.sub: For non-EEA students in the Netherlands.
scenes.say: The N L Scholarship, once called the Holland Scholarship, is open for twenty twenty-seven to twenty-eight.

scenes.title: paid in your first year
scenes.say: It is five thousand euros, paid in your first year. It is not a full-tuition scholarship.

scenes.title: Who can apply
items: No previous degree from a Dutch institution
scenes.say: You need a non E E A nationality, a full-time bachelor's or master's place, and no previous degree from a Dutch institution.

scenes.title: Apply through the university
scenes.body: Each university sets its own NL Scholarship deadlines.
scenes.say: You apply through the participating university, and each one sets its own deadlines. Check your university's page.
